cards.title: Alberta personal and family responsibility leave
cards.body: Eligible employees in Alberta can take up to 5 days of unpaid, job-protected leave each calendar year to meet family responsibilities for a family member. You give your employer notice as soon as is reasonable before taking the leave.

details.label: Pay
details.value: Unpaid unless an employment contract or collective agreement says otherwise

cards.draftNotice:
Hello,

I am giving notice that I need to take personal and family responsibility leave for a family caregiving situation. I will confirm the dates I need as soon as I can.

Thank you.

cards.title: EI caregiving benefits
cards.body: EI caregiving benefits may apply if a medical doctor or nurse practitioner certifies that the person is critically ill or injured, or needs end-of-life care. Other eligibility requirements apply; this is not an eligibility decision.

cards.title: Family Caregiver Centre (Alberta Health Services, Calgary Zone)
cards.body: Information, education and support for family and friends who give unpaid care to someone with a health condition.

details.label: Hours
details.value: Tuesday to Thursday, 8:00 am to 4:00 pm

cards.title: Health Link 811
cards.body: A free phone line, open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, for health advice and information.

cards.title: Caregivers Alberta
cards.body: Coaching, peer support groups, education and resources for unpaid family caregivers in Alberta.

cards.title: 211 Alberta
cards.body: Free, confidential help finding community and social supports by phone, text or chat, any time.

cards.title: Caregivers Support Group (Unison Society)
cards.body: A monthly support group where caregivers connect, talk about the ups and downs of caregiving and learn about useful topics.

cards.title: Caregiver Kindness (Calgary Seniors' Resource Society)
cards.body: Weekly volunteer visits to a senior that give the caregiver 1 to 2 hours of respite.

cards.title: Respite Connect (Independent Living Resource Centre of Calgary)
cards.body: Vetted respite workers for families and caregivers.

cards.title: Caregiver Support Program (Jewish Family Service Calgary)
cards.body: Counselling, group sessions, education and resources for unpaid caregivers of seniors, open to all faiths and backgrounds.

cards.title: Support Services for Seniors (The Way In Network)
cards.body: Information, referrals, benefit applications and caregiver support for Calgarians aged 65 and older living independently.

cards.title: Distress Centre Calgary
cards.body: Free 24-hour crisis support by phone, text and chat, plus counselling.

cards.title: Nearest hospital: Foothills Hospital
cards.body: In an emergency, call 911. For health questions, call Health Link at 811.
